name: 17 锁定延迟（玩家局：重力触底后 0.5s 缓冲才锁）

asserts.source:
local logs = query.logs()
local ldAt, lockAt = 0, 0
for i, l in ipairs(logs) do
  if l:match('^ldstart') and ldAt == 0 then ldAt = i end
  if l:match('^lock S ') and lockAt == 0 then lockAt = i end
end
assert(ldAt > 0, 'no ldstart')
assert(lockAt > 0, 'no lock S')
assert(lockAt > ldAt, 'S locked before/at ldstart! lockAt=' .. lockAt .. ' ldAt=' .. ldAt)
for i = ldAt, lockAt - 1 do
  assert(not logs[i]:match('^lock '), 'other lock during delay at ' .. i)
end
return true

asserts.contains: clear n=2 score=335 lines=2 combo=1 b2b=0
